title: Link Health Checker input
description: Give it one or more start URLs. It crawls pages on the same site, checks every link it finds, and saves one row per unique URL. robots.txt is always respected.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Pages to start from, for example https://example.com/. Only sites you own or are allowed to audit. Up to 20.

maxPages.title: Maximum pages to crawl
maxPages.description: How many pages on your own site are opened and parsed for links.

maxDepth.title: Maximum click depth
maxDepth.description: 0 = only the start URLs. Pages deeper than this are still checked for status but not opened.

maxLinks.title: Maximum rows saved
maxLinks.description: Hard cap on dataset rows and therefore on cost: each saved row is one billable event.

checkExternal.title: Check external links
checkExternal.description: Also check links that point to other websites (one request each, never crawled).

useSitemap.title: Seed from sitemap
useSitemap.description: Add URLs from the site's sitemap (found via robots.txt or /sitemap.xml) so pages not linked from the start page are covered too.

onlyProblems.title: Save only rows with problems
onlyProblems.description: Skip rows that have no issues. You are billed only for rows that are saved.

concurrency.title: Parallel requests
concurrency.description: Total in-flight requests. Requests to the same host are additionally spaced by the delay below.

delayMs.title: Delay between requests to one host (ms)
delayMs.description: Minimum gap between two requests to the same host. Raise it for small or slow sites.

timeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: How long to wait for one URL before it is reported as a timeout.
